title: TW-LegalBench: Measuring Taiwanese Legal Understanding

live_model.evidence: closed-source models (claude-sonnet-4.5 (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929), gpt-5 (gpt-5-2025-08-07), gpt-5.2 (gpt-5.2-2025-12-11), and gpt-4o (gpt-4o-2024-08-06)) (Section 4); temperature 1 for gpt-5

prompt.location: Section 4.1 only describes distinct system/user prompts with JSON output; no appendix
prompt.note: Zero-shot CoT prompts per task are not printed.

data.source: MCQs from Ministry of Examination (wwwc.moex.gov.tw) and judgments from opendata.judicial.gov.tw; benchmark described as open to the public but no URL in the text

notes: OEQ scores use gpt-5 and claude-sonnet-4.5 as judges (LLM-judge dependency); MCQ accuracy is key-based. Cost estimate assumes all 16,493 MCQs with CoT output.
